parts.context: Nadia, who works in the marketing department, phones Kevin at the IT helpdesk.

script.speaker: Nadia
script.text: Hi Kevin, it's Nadia in Marketing. We've moved to the third floor, and I can't print anything. My laptop keeps sending documents to the old printer on the first floor.

script.speaker: Kevin
script.text: OK, let's add the third-floor printer. First, could you click the Start button and open Settings? It's the small gear icon.

script.speaker: Nadia
script.text: OK, I've got the Settings window.

script.speaker: Kevin
script.text: Now select Devices, and then click Printers and scanners in the menu on the left.

script.speaker: Nadia
script.text: Right. There's a button that says Add a printer.

script.speaker: Kevin
script.text: Yes, click that. The laptop will search the network. It usually takes about thirty seconds.

script.speaker: Nadia
script.text: It's found three printers. Which one is mine?

script.speaker: Kevin
script.text: Choose the one called Floor 3 Colour. Then click Add device.

script.speaker: Kevin
script.text: Great. Next, just tick the box that says Set as default, so that all your documents go to this printer automatically.

script.speaker: Kevin
script.text: Finally, print a test page to check that everything works.

parts.context: Grace, the manager of a university Media Lab, shows a group of new students around the lab.

script.speaker: Grace
script.text: Hello, and welcome to the Media Lab. I'm Grace, and I manage the lab. Let me tell you what we have here.

script.speaker: Grace
script.text: There are twenty computers in this room. Each one has a 27-inch screen and a powerful graphics card, so you can edit videos and 3-D images quickly. All the computers have the same software, so you can use any desk.

script.speaker: Grace
script.text: Along the back wall, we have six video cameras for filming projects. You can borrow a camera for up to three days, but you have to book it online first. In the small room on the left, there are four sets of virtual reality goggles. Students usually use them for game design projects.

script.speaker: Grace
script.text: The lab is open from nine in the morning to eight in the evening, Monday to Saturday. Finally, please save your work on the university server, not on the computers, because we clean all the computers every Sunday night. Any questions?

questions.explanation: "Each one has a 27-inch screen".

questions.stem: How many video cameras does the lab have?
questions.explanation: "we have six video cameras for filming projects".

questions.stem: For how long can a student borrow a camera?
questions.explanation: "You can borrow a camera for up to three days".

questions.stem: What do students usually use the virtual reality goggles for?
questions.explanation: "Students usually use them for game design projects."

questions.stem: When does the lab clean all the computers?
questions.explanation: "we clean all the computers every Sunday night".

items.explanation: Pane (khung, ô cửa sổ) là một vùng riêng trong cửa sổ máy tính, hiển thị một phần chương trình hoặc một nhóm tệp.
Boot drive (ổ khởi động) là ổ đĩa dùng để chạy chương trình khởi động, giúp máy tính sẵn sàng sử dụng.
Licence terms (điều khoản giấy phép) là các điều kiện do nhà phát triển phần mềm đặt ra để người dùng được sử dụng chương trình.
Trainee (thực tập sinh, người đang được đào tạo) là người đang được đào tạo cho một công việc.
Microphone (micrô) là thiết bị để nói vào nhằm ghi âm hoặc khuếch đại giọng nói. Định nghĩa C là của video camera (máy quay video), không có trong danh sách thuật ngữ.

grammar.stem: A nanosecond is one ______ of a second.
grammar.explanation: Tiền tố nano- nghĩa là một phần tỷ: 1 nanosecond = 1/1.000.000.000 giây. Một phần nghìn là milli-, một phần triệu là micro-.

grammar.stem: The processor runs at 3.05 GHz. How do we say '3.05 GHz'?
grammar.explanation: Số thập phân đọc "point" rồi đọc từng chữ số sau dấu chấm: 3.05 = three point zero five. Tiếng Anh không đọc dấu thập phân là "comma".

grammar.stem: First, open the Settings menu. ______, select 'Update'. Finally, click 'Install now'.
grammar.explanation: Bước giữa trong chuỗi First … Finally dùng từ nối "Then". First và Finally đã dùng cho bước đầu và bước cuối; "Before" không đứng một mình làm từ nối trình tự.

grammar.stem: Connect the printer ______ the laptop with a USB cable.
grammar.explanation: Câu hai tân ngữ: connect + tân ngữ 1 + to + tân ngữ 2 (connect the printer to the laptop).

grammar.stem: ______ the USB stick from the port before you leave.
grammar.explanation: Giới từ "from" đi với động từ chỉ việc lấy ra: remove sth from sth. Insert, plug đi với "into"; connect đi với "to".

grammar.stem: We need a webcam ______ video calls with our clients.
grammar.explanation: Chỉ mục đích bằng for + cụm danh từ (video calls). "to" cần động từ, "so that" và "because" cần mệnh đề có chủ ngữ và động từ.

grammar.stem: Close the other programs ______ the installation runs faster.
grammar.explanation: Sau chỗ trống là mệnh đề (the installation runs faster) chỉ mục đích: dùng "so that". for / because of cần danh từ, to cần động từ nguyên mẫu.

vocabulary.stem: Open a new ______ in your browser so that you can look at two websites at the same time.
vocabulary.explanation: Tab (thẻ) là một vùng trong cửa sổ cho phép mở nhiều trang, tài liệu cùng lúc.

vocabulary.stem: Click the ______ next to 'Remember me' if you don't want to type your password every time.
vocabulary.explanation: Tick box (ô đánh dấu) là ô nhỏ để đánh dấu chọn một mục, ví dụ "Remember me".

vocabulary.stem: The ______ shows our slides on the big screen in the meeting room.
vocabulary.explanation: Projector (máy chiếu) làm hình ảnh, slide hiện lên màn hình hoặc mặt phẳng lớn.

vocabulary.stem: ______ the power cable before you open the computer case.
vocabulary.explanation: Unplug (rút phích cắm) là ngắt điện thiết bị bằng cách rút phích ra khỏi ổ cắm.

vocabulary.stem: This laptop has a very fast ______, so it can run several programs at the same time.
vocabulary.explanation: CPU (bộ xử lý trung tâm) điều khiển hoạt động của máy; CPU nhanh thì chạy được nhiều chương trình cùng lúc.

vocabulary.stem: To add more memory, insert a new memory module into the empty ______ on the motherboard.
vocabulary.explanation: DIMM slot (khe cắm DIMM) là chỗ cắm thanh nhớ DIMM để tăng bộ nhớ RAM. Ethernet connector dùng để nối mạng.

vocabulary.stem: Before you install the new operating system, ______ all your files to an external drive.
vocabulary.explanation: Back up (sao lưu) là tạo bản sao dữ liệu: back up files to an external drive.

vocabulary.stem: The ______ in this video is very poor, so it's hard to hear what people are saying.
vocabulary.explanation: Audio (phần âm thanh) là phần ghi âm thanh, không có hình. Khó nghe là do audio kém.

passage.title: Review: The Nimbus Mini PC
paragraphs: The Nimbus Mini PC is a tiny desktop computer. It is only 12 centimetres wide and weighs just 600 grams, so it fits easily behind a monitor or on a small shelf. The company that makes it says it is ideal for home offices, school classrooms and small shops.

Inside the case, there is a 3.2 GHz six-core processor and 16 GB of memory. Customers can choose a 512 GB or a 1 TB solid state drive. In our tests, the computer was very quiet, and it ran office software, video calls and online games without any problems. However, it does not have a separate graphics card, so it is not powerful enough for professional video editing.

On the front, there are two USB ports and a headphone socket. On the back, you will find two more USB ports, an Ethernet connector and two video sockets, so that you can connect the computer to two monitors at the same time. There is no optical drive, but you can plug an external DVD drive into one of the USB ports if you need one.

The Nimbus costs £450 with the smaller drive and £520 with the larger one. A keyboard and a mouse come in the box, but you have to buy a monitor separately. Our verdict: the Nimbus is a good choice for anyone who needs a fast, quiet computer and does not have much space on their desk.

questions.stem: Why does the Nimbus fit easily behind a monitor?

options.text: It is very small and light.
It comes with a special shelf.

questions.explanation: Đoạn 1: máy chỉ rộng 12 cm, nặng 600 g "so it fits easily behind a monitor or on a small shelf".

questions.stem: What is the Nimbus NOT powerful enough for?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2: máy không có card đồ hoạ rời "so it is not powerful enough for professional video editing". Ba việc còn lại máy chạy tốt.

questions.stem: How many USB ports does the Nimbus have in total?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3: mặt trước có hai cổng USB, mặt sau có "two more USB ports", tổng cộng bốn.

questions.stem: Why does the Nimbus have two video sockets?

options.text: So that you can connect it to two monitors at the same time
So that you can play DVDs without an external drive
For headphones and other audio devices

questions.explanation: Đoạn 3: "two video sockets, so that you can connect the computer to two monitors at the same time".

questions.stem: How much does the Nimbus with the 1 TB drive cost?
questions.explanation: Đoạn 4: £450 với ổ nhỏ hơn (512 GB), £520 với ổ lớn hơn (1 TB).

passageTrueFalse.instructions: Read the passage and write T (True) or F (False) (Questions 26–30).

passage.title: How to Use Split Screen
paragraphs: Do you often work with two documents at the same time? Split screen lets you see two windows side by side, so you don't have to switch between them all the time. This is useful, for example, when you copy information from a website into a report.

First, open both programs. Then click on the title bar of the first window and drag it to the left edge of the screen. When you release the mouse button, the window fills the left half of the screen. Next, small pictures of your other open windows appear on the right. Just click on one of them, and it fills the right half.

To make one window bigger than the other, slide the line between the two windows to the left or to the right. If you want to return to a full-screen window, click its maximise button. You can also split the screen with the keyboard: hold down the Windows key and press the left or right arrow key.

questions.statement: Split screen shows two windows side by side.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 1: "Split screen lets you see two windows side by side".

questions.statement: You drag the first window to the right edge of the screen.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2: kéo cửa sổ đầu tiên "to the left edge of the screen" (cạnh trái).

questions.statement: When you release the mouse button, the first window fills the whole screen.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 2: cửa sổ "fills the left half of the screen" (nửa trái), không phải toàn màn hình.

questions.statement: The two windows must always be the same size.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3: "To make one window bigger than the other, slide the line between the two windows", nên hai cửa sổ có thể khác kích thước.

questions.statement: You can split the screen with the Windows key and an arrow key.
questions.explanation: Đoạn 3: "hold down the Windows key and press the left or right arrow key".

targetGrammar: Imperatives with sequence words: First, … Then, … Next, … After that, … Finally, …
Sentences with two objects: plug the drive into a USB port, unplug the drive from the laptop
Reason and purpose: to + verb, so that + clause
email.modelAnswer:
From: Le Quang Huy
To: Sophie
Date: 8th April
Subject: Backing up your files

Hi Sophie,

It should be quite easy to back up your files to the external drive.
First, plug the drive into a USB port on your laptop.
Then, open File Explorer and select the folders you want to back up.
Next, just drag them onto the drive icon to copy them.
After that, check that the files are on the drive.
Finally, right-click on the drive icon, select 'Eject' and unplug the drive from the laptop.
Don't forget to lock the drive in your drawer when you've finished.

Best wishes,
Le Quang Huy
Support Technician
Help Desk Department

parts.instructions: Answer the three questions. Speak for 30–45 seconds for each question.
questions: How much storage does your phone or laptop have, and how much of it is free? Say the numbers and units clearly, for example sixty-four gigabytes or one point five terabytes.
What multimedia equipment do you have at home, for example speakers, a webcam or headphones? What do you use each one for? Use for + noun, to + verb or so that.
How do you save a document in a new folder on your computer? Give the instructions using imperatives and sequence words (first, then, next, finally).

parts.instructions: Give instructions for using a computer. Speak for 1–1.5 minutes.
parts.prompt: Your grandmother has a new laptop. Explain how to change the desktop background to one of her own photos. Use imperatives, sequence words (first, then, next, after that, finally) and at least one softener (could you…?, just).
cues: right-click on an empty part of the desktop
click 'Browse' / find the photo in the Pictures folder
requiredGrammar: Imperatives with sequence words: First, … Then, … Next, … After that, … Finally, …
parts.sampleAnswer: It's easy to change the background, Grandma. First, could you right-click on an empty part of the desktop? Not on an icon, just on the picture behind them. A menu appears. Then select 'Personalise' from the menu. A new window opens. Next, click 'Background' on the left and choose 'Picture' from the list. After that, click the 'Browse' button and find your photo. Your photos are usually in the Pictures folder, so just double click on that folder and select the photo you like. Finally, click 'Choose picture'. Now you can see your photo on the desktop. If you like it, just close the window. If you don't like it, repeat the steps and choose another photo.

parts.instructions: Deal with the situation. Speak for 1–1.5 minutes.
parts.prompt: Your friend owns a small café. She wants to show music videos on a big TV and play music through speakers, and she wants customers to see the café's menu on the TV screen too. Explain what equipment she needs, how to connect each item and why each one is needed. Use sentences with two objects (plug … into …, connect … to …) and reason or purpose (to…, so that…, because…, for…).
cues: a small media player: plug it into the TV's HDMI socket / to play music videos from the internet
two speakers: connect them to the media player / so that customers at the back can hear the music
a laptop: connect it to the TV with a cable / for showing the café's menu
an extension cable: plug it into the wall socket / because there is only one socket near the TV
requiredGrammar: Sentences with two objects: plug … into …, connect … to …
Reason and purpose: to + verb, so that + clause, because + clause, for + noun / -ing
parts.sampleAnswer: I think you need four things. First, buy a small media player and plug it into the TV's HDMI socket. You need it to play music videos from the internet. Second, get two speakers and connect them to the media player, so that customers at the back of the café can hear the music clearly. The TV speakers are too quiet for a big room. Third, you can connect your laptop to the TV with a cable for showing the café's menu between the videos. Finally, you need an extension cable, because there is only one wall socket near the TV. Plug the extension cable into the wall socket, and then plug the TV, the media player and the speakers into it. It's quite cheap, and it's easy to set up.
